## About
Ruppels Auto Fixation is a small shop on East Lane, next to the Burlingame train station. Owner Ken Schrum opened it at this location and still works on cars himself. He lives in San Mateo County and has a soft spot for classic cars.
We handle mechanical repair and service on most domestic and foreign models, from old to present. The shop is small on purpose, with clean, well-lit workstations and a full time Master ASE certified technician, so we can give you more personal attention than a dealer.
Customers have given us a 5 star rating across 96 Google reviews. Stop by, ask Ken your technical questions, and see how we work.

## Services
- Brake service and repair: Brake repair and service, plus brake and lamp inspections.
- Air conditioning, ventilation and heating: Diagnosis and repair when your car's air or heat isn't working right.
- Oil and filter change: Routine oil and filter service to keep your engine healthy.
- Factory scheduled maintenance: Maintenance on the schedule your car's maker recommends.
- Engine performance diagnosis: Finding the cause when your car isn't running the way it should.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge to take a first look at my car?
A: We offer free preliminary inspections.

Q: Can I leave my car overnight?
A: Yes. Ask about our drop-off service. We always phone you when your car is ready, and if you need to leave it overnight, we can accommodate that.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: American, European and Asian cars.

Q: How do I pay?
A: We accept all major credit cards.

Q: Where are you located?
A: At 260 East Lane in Burlingame, next to the Burlingame train station.
